newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CAM appoints auditor to investigate.
newsitem.headline: CAM appoints auditor to investigate.

text.p: CAM International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had appointed auditors Price Waterhouse to assess the financial impact from matters raised in a special audit review report on the company and some subsidiaries.
Singapore's Commercial Affairs Department (CAD) has been looking into fraud allegations related to the precision engineering group after the Ernst & Young special audit review.

Ernst & Young told the Finance Ministry in April that two directors withheld information from CAM's board on the true nature of a multi-million dollar debt owed to a Malaysian subsidiary by a third party.
The company statement said Price Waterhouse will investigate and review previous transactions of the group and notify the board of material irregularities.
Price Waterhouse will try to complete its assignment and report its findings and recommendations to the board by end June 1997.
